attempts.text:
This plan costs 166 minutes in total. Gosaikunda care home is only reachable through Kalika farm, so rescuing its 3 adults would take about 160 minutes of driving against a 60-minute deferral penalty. I defer them.

The car has 4 seats. The plan makes two round trips from the shelter:

1. **Dhunche trip (22 min):** pick up the injured person and 2 children, who carry the highest penalties, and bring them to the shelter.
2. **Gajuri trip (64 min):** pick up 4 of the 5 adults and bring them to the shelter. A second trip for the fifth adult would cost 64 minutes against a 20-minute penalty, so I defer that adult.

Driving is 22 + 64 = 86 minutes. Penalties are 4 adults × 20 = 80 minutes.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village gajuri-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 gajuri-farm dhunche-village
drive car1 dhunche-village tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer gajuri-farm adult 1
defer gosaikunda-care-home adult 3
</plan>
COST: 166
